scope: The 50 references already cited by RESEARCH.md plus a bounded 2024-2026 update search.

limitations: This is a reproducible bounded citation audit, not a systematic review.
One screener performed the review; independent human citation review remains required before submission.
Metadata and abstract inspection support only the narrow uses recorded below.
Search-engine coverage and indexing are incomplete and time-dependent.
